Subject: Post-call recap: Marketplace procurement & PO vs Card - LumenAI

Hi Sophie - great to chat earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: Pilot Redwood inference (hosted + dedicated option) for LumenAI data ingestion pipeline; target start mid-May.
- Procurement preference: your team wants to evaluate AWS Marketplace route but may need a PO-based contract for finance.
- Volume: estimated $75k-$120k annual commitment if pilot converts to production.

Questions / open items (asks from Redwood):
1) Procurement path: Do you want to go through AWS Marketplace (private offer) or direct PO/contract with Redwood? Which does your procurement prefer for vendor onboarding?
2) Payment method: Card for initial month vs PO for formal purchase - is that acceptable? Any threshold where procurement requires PO immediately?
3) Procurement & legal contacts: please confirm the procurement owner (name/email) and whether we should send a marketplace private offer or a vendor quote/PO-ready invoice.

Attached: Redwood_Marketplace_Onboarding_Steps.docx - outlines marketplace private-offer timeline and what's required from your side.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm procurement path and timeline.
- If marketplace: we set a 30-min private-offer onboarding call with our partnerships team and prepare a private offer.
- If PO: we'll prepare a PO-ready invoice + SOW and share the LumenAI PO template back for signatures.

Happy to set up a call with Marissa (sales ops) and Jonas (marketplace partnerships) if helpful.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes

Thanks Camila - this is helpful. A few answers from our side:

- Procurement preference: We prefer AWS Marketplace if possible because it allows us to keep vendor spend consolidated under our marketplace contracts and simplifies procurement approval for infra-like purchases.
- Payment method: Finance prefers PO for anything > $50k. For a pilot under $10k we normally approve a card, but given the expected pilot size (~$20k over 6-8 weeks) they may ask for a PO.
- Timeline: We are targeting a May 15 start but need procurement to sign off by early May at the latest.

I've attached our PO template for your ops team to review. Will introduce Daniel (cc) - he's our procurement owner and will be the one to approve the PO or the marketplace private offer.

A couple of asks from us:
1) Can you send a PO-ready quote (line items + billing contact + SOW) we can attach to our PO submission?
2) If we go marketplace: can you confirm the private-offer flow and any lead times from your partnerships team?

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Head of Platform & Integrations | LumenAI
sophie.turner@lumenai.com
